implementation.retained_read: Preserve cached archive rows and selection through transient errors; initial/empty-cache errors remain errors; HTTP 401/403/404 hides data and result.
implementation.confirmed_restore: Cancel older project reads, update matching canonical records in existing cache arrays, announce confirmed result independently, refresh without awaiting.
implementation.unknown_restore: Retain unresolved ids in this mounted section; explicit owner-scoped full-list GET separates restored, still archived and unavailable. Failed checks remain uncertain; prohibit new restore/delete until checked.
implementation.selection: Derive actionable ids from the current rendered archived rows. Fence old callbacks and recheck original ids after deletion confirmation; changed scope issues no deletion. Not a server atomic precondition.
implementation.result_owner: One result survives loading/empty/error outside data aria-busy. Explicit Check may cancel older reads. Focus owner persists until actual node removal or a different chosen control.

implementation.counter_evidence: Default invalidateQueries swallows ordinary read errors; they do not themselves invoke mutation.onError. Held query refresh delays and simulated lost write acknowledgements are separate observations.
